app.name: Marea
setup.title: Connect to your Marea
setup.lead: Type your Marea's address, the same one you use in your browser.
setup.label: Your Marea's address
setup.hint: Don't know it? Ask whoever runs your team's Marea.
connecting.title: Connecting to {name}…
offline.title: Can't reach your Marea
error.invalid: That address isn't valid. Type it like marea.yourcompany.com
error.https: Your Marea must use https (the padlock), so nobody can read what goes back and forth.
error.credentials: The address can't include a username or password.
error.timeout: Your Marea isn't answering: you may be offline or the server may be down.
error.unreachable: That address can't be reached. Check it's spelled right and that you're online.
error.connect: Can't connect to that address. Check it's spelled right.
error.redirect: That address leads somewhere else. Type your Marea's exact address.
error.not_marea: That address answers, but it isn't a Marea.
error.not_installed: That Marea isn't installed yet (or can't reach its database).
error.window: The Marea window can't be found.
error.permission: Couldn't set up the connection to your Marea: {error}
error.no_server: You haven't chosen a Marea yet.
download.done.title: Download complete
download.failed.title: Download failed
download.failed.body: {name} couldn't be saved. Please try again.
tray.hint.title: Marea is still running
tray.hint.body: So your notifications keep arriving, it stays next to the clock. To close it completely, choose “Quit Marea” from its icon.
update.title: New version
update.body:
A new version of Marea for desktop is available: {new} (you have {current}).

It downloads from GitHub; installing it replaces the one you have, and you stay signed in.
update.uptodate.title: You're up to date
update.uptodate.body: You have the latest version of Marea for desktop ({current}).
update.error.title: Couldn't check
update.error.body: Couldn't check for a new version: {error}
update.err.none: no version has been published yet
